Rishi —

Good call. I can own the prompt playbook and lead the prompt review. Suggested workshop flow (90–120m):

1) Intros & objectives (10m)
2) Prompt playbook walkthrough + canonical prompts (25m)
   - We'll review target instruction templates and scoring expectations
3) Routing matrix overview (15m)
   - Primary model / quantized variant / fallback mapping per route
4) Hands-on prompt tuning (30–40m)
   - Live iterations, evaluation checklist, regression watch points
5) Load rehearsal planning (20m)
   - Spike test windows, expected token volumes, KV-cache priming plan
6) Success criteria + next steps (10m)

I attached a short Pre-Kickoff Checklist and the first pass of a routing matrix (routing-matrix-v1.xlsx). I'll also draft a runbook skeleton we can finalize before the session.

Attachments: Pre-Kickoff Checklist.docx (checklist), routing-matrix-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
